projects.name: Interactive Terminal Portfolio
projects.description: Arch Linux + Hyprland desktop simulated in the browser: dwindle tiling, waybar, wofi launcher, animated window spawns, and a kitty terminal shell.
projects.longDescription: A ricer-grade recreation of an Arch Linux + Hyprland rice running entirely client-side. Boots through a fake BIOS/POST, systemd log and SDDM login into a Catppuccin desktop with a waybar, wofi-style launcher, Super-key bindings, dwindle tiling across five workspaces, and a fastfetch landing card. Fully theme-switchable at runtime.
features: Dwindle tiling window manager with floating toggle and five workspaces.
Full boot sequence: BIOS to systemd to SDDM login to Hyprland startup.
Waybar, wofi launcher, Super-key bindings, and runtime Catppuccin theming.

projects.name: Enterprise RAG Pipeline
projects.description: High-performance RAG pipeline parsing massive document hubs using LangChain, sentence-transformers, and FAISS. Supports real-time QA and query caching.
projects.longDescription: An end-to-end question answering pipeline built to handle gigabytes of unstructured documents. Features hybrid BM25 and vector embeddings search, automated query reranking, and self-corrective retrieval logic.
features: Dynamic document chunking with semantic headers overlap.
Query expansion using OpenAI GPT model endpoints.

projects.name: Typing Speed Test Engine
projects.description: A fast terminal-based typing speed tester with real-time WPM, accuracy calculations, and neat ANSI colors.
projects.longDescription: High-performance native command-line typing simulator utilizing multi-threading for accurate microsecond keyboard event tracking. Generates stats summaries and performance reports.
features: Multithreaded keyboard listener for latency-free tracking.
Real-time calculations of words-per-minute (WPM) and accuracy.
Full support for custom input paragraphs.
